title: Survey 1: Sports complex or library
summary: City budget: a new indoor sports complex, or longer library hours and a new branch.

tasks.label: Task 2: Responding to Survey Questions
tasks.scenario: Your city council has received extra funding and can afford only one new project. It is asking residents which project it should choose.
tasks.instructions: Choose the option that you prefer. Explain the reasons for your choice.

options.text: Build an indoor sports complex with a pool, a gym and courts that are open all year.
Extend public library hours to evenings and weekends, and open a new branch in a growing neighbourhood.

title: Survey 2: Four-day week or hybrid work
summary: Your employer is choosing a new work schedule for all staff.

tasks.label: Task 2: Responding to Survey Questions
tasks.scenario: The company you work for wants to improve work-life balance and is asking employees to choose between two new schedules.
tasks.instructions: Choose the option that you prefer. Explain the reasons for your choice.

options.text: A four-day week: everyone works four 10-hour days in the office and has a three-day weekend.
A hybrid week: everyone works five 8-hour days, with two days a week from home.

title: Survey 3: Phones in classrooms
summary: School board policy: a full classroom phone ban, or limited use for learning.

tasks.label: Task 2: Responding to Survey Questions
tasks.scenario: Your local school board is reviewing its policy on students' mobile phones and has asked parents and community members for their opinion.
tasks.instructions: Choose the option that you prefer. Explain the reasons for your choice.

options.text: Ban phones in all classrooms. Students must keep them in their lockers during class time.
Allow phones in class for learning activities only, when the teacher permits it.

title: Survey 4: Community garden or parking
summary: What to do with an empty lot near local shops.

tasks.label: Task 2: Responding to Survey Questions
tasks.scenario: There is an empty lot beside the small shopping street in your neighbourhood. The neighbourhood association is deciding what to do with it.
tasks.instructions: Choose the option that you prefer. Explain the reasons for your choice.

options.text: Turn the lot into a community garden where residents can rent small plots to grow vegetables and flowers.
Turn the lot into a public parking area for 40 cars to make it easier to visit the local shops.

title: Survey 5: Free transit or better service
summary: Public transit: free fares paid for by taxes, or the same fares with more frequent buses.

tasks.label: Task 2: Responding to Survey Questions
tasks.scenario: Your city wants more people to use public transit and is asking residents to choose between two plans.
tasks.instructions: Choose the option that you prefer. Explain the reasons for your choice.

options.text: Make all buses and trains free, paid for by a small increase in property taxes.
Keep the current fares, and use the money to run buses and trains twice as often.

title: Survey 6: Volunteer hours for graduation
summary: Should high-school students have to volunteer in order to graduate?

tasks.label: Task 2: Responding to Survey Questions
tasks.scenario: Your provincial government is considering a change to high-school graduation requirements and has opened a public survey.
tasks.instructions: Choose the option that you prefer. Explain the reasons for your choice.

options.text: Require every student to complete 60 hours of community volunteering before graduating.
Make volunteering optional, but give students course credit for the hours they complete.
